本次建站主要是围绕Obsidian和Osidian git插件加上Hugo完成的笔记录入,blog自动构建 首先由主仓库notes组成使用github workflow来自动完成.md转换成静态网页

 1name: github pages
 2
 3on:
 4  push:
 5    branches:
 6      - main  # Set a branch that will trigger a deploymen
 7
 8jobs:
 9  deploy:
10    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
11    steps:
12      - uses: actions/checkout@v4 
13        with:
14          submodules: true  # Fetch Hugo themes (true OR recursive)
15          fetch-depth: 0    # Fetch all history for .GitInfo and .Lastmod
16          path: main
17      - name: Setup Hugo
18        uses: peaceiris/actions-hugo@v2
19        with:
20              hugo-version: 0.120.4
21              extended: true
22      - name: Checkout tools repo
23        uses: actions/checkout@v4
24        with:
25          submodules: true  # Fetch Hugo themes (true OR recursive)
26          fetch-depth: 0    # Fetch all history for .GitInfo and .Lastmod
27          repository: Noirkelo/blog
28          path: blog
29      - name: Set up Python 3.10
30        uses: actions/setup-python@v1
31        with:
32          python-version: 3.10.18 
33      - name: Delete
34        run: rm -rf ./main/template
35      - name: Install dependencies
36        run: |
37          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
38          pip install obsidian-to-hugo
39          python -m obsidian_to_hugo --obsidian-vault-dir=./main --hugo-content-dir=./blog/content          
40      
41      - name: Build Web
42        run: cd blog && hugo --minify
43      - name: Deploy to Github pages
44        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
45        with:
46          external_repository: Noirkelo/noirkelo.github.io
47          publish_dir: ./blog/public
48          deploy_key: ${{ secrets.ACTIONS_DEPLOY_KEY }}
49

item.content:encoded:
以下是未完工的想法

Summary

给zed添加smooth scroll

Motivation

更好的视觉效果

Detailed design

我在原有的分支做了一定修改至少证明了这个拦截修改思路其实没错就是没有做动画补间 我搞清楚neovide 计算vsync计算每一帧的时间 如果滚动距离过长那就截取到达地点的作为动画 使用阻尼弹簧并且截断部分动画实现这个效果

 1...
 2fn animate(&mut self) {
 3	if self.window_wrapper.skia_renderer.is_none() {
 4		return;
 5	}
 6	let skia_renderer = self.window_wrapper.skia_renderer.as_ref().unwrap();
 7	let vsync = self.window_wrapper.vsync.as_ref().unwrap();
 8
 9	let dt =
10		Duration::from_secs_f32(vsync.get_refresh_rate(skia_renderer.window(), &self.settings));
11
12	let now = Instant::now();
13	let target_animation_time = now - self.animation_start;
14	let mut delta = target_animation_time.saturating_sub(self.animation_time);
15	// Don't try to animate way too big deltas
16	// Instead reset the animation times, and simulate a single frame
17	if delta > Duration::from_millis(1000) {
18		self.animation_start = now;
19		self.animation_time = Duration::ZERO;
20		delta = dt;
21	}
22	// Catchup immediately if the delta is more than one frame, otherwise smooth it over 10 frames
23	let catchup = if delta >= dt {
24		delta
25	} else {
26		delta.div_f64(10.0)
27	};
28
29	let dt = dt + catchup;
30	tracy_plot!("Simulation dt", dt.as_secs_f64());
31	self.animation_time += dt;
32
33	let num_steps = (dt.as_secs_f64() / MAX_ANIMATION_DT).ceil() as u32;
34	let step = dt / num_steps;
35	for _ in 0..num_steps {
36		if self.window_wrapper.animate_frame(step.as_secs_f32()) {
37			self.should_render = ShouldRender::Immediately;
38		}
39	}
40}
41...

我在原有分支做了如下原型,重点解决卡顿问题主要是neovide导入的动画 https://github.com/Noirkelo/zed/tree/hocman2-smooth-scroll

 1//copy from neovide
 2
 3#[derive(Clone)]
 4pub struct CriticallyDampedSpringAnimation {
 5    pub position: f32,
 6    velocity: f32,
 7}
 8
 9impl CriticallyDampedSpringAnimation {
10    pub fn new() -> Self {
11        Self {
12            position: 0.0,
13            velocity: 0.0,
14        }
15    }
16
17    pub fn update(&mut self, dt: f32, animation_length: f32) -> bool {
18        if animation_length <= dt {
19            self.reset();
20            return false;
21        }
22
23        if self.position == 0.0 {
24            return false;
25        }
26
27        // Simulate a critically damped spring, also known as a PD controller.
28        // For more details of why this was chosen, see this:
29        // https://gdcvault.com/play/1027059/Math-In-Game-Development-Summit
30        // < 1 underdamped,  1 critically damped, > 1 overdamped
31        let zeta = 1.0;
32        // The omega is calculated so that the destination is reached with a 2% tolerance in
33        // animation_length time.
34        let omega = 4.0 / (zeta * animation_length);
35
36        // Use the analytica formula for critically damped harmonic oscillation
37        // a and b are the intial conditions by setting dt to zero and solving the position and
38        // velocity respectively
39        let a = self.position;
40        let b = self.position * omega + self.velocity;
41        let c = (-omega * dt).exp();
42        self.position = (a + b * dt) * c;
43        self.velocity = c * (-a * omega - b * dt * omega + b);
44        if self.position.abs() < 0.01 {
45            self.reset();
46            false
47        } else {
48            true
49        }
50
51    }
52
53    pub fn reset(&mut self) {
54        self.position = 0.0;
55        self.velocity = 0.0;
56
57    }
58
59
60}

接下来具体来说主要是不应该像已经被拒绝过的那个人的pr一样手动编写动画相关组件 思路是在SmoothScroll保存一个WeakEntity<Editor>这样就可以创建一个不可见的gpui::Component 然后通过animation_ix和保存的SmoothScroll获取WeakEntity<SmoothScroll> 我们只需要拦截并计算每次set_anchor的值即可

 2	fn render(self, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut App) -> impl IntoElement {
 3        AnimationExt::with_animations(self, "placehoder", 
 4	vec![
 5			Animation::new(Duration::from_secs(1)),
 6			Animation::new(Duration::from_secs(1)),
 7		], 
 8move |scroll, animation_ix, delta| {
 9                    match animation_ix {
10                        0 => {
11							dbg!(delta);
12                        }
13                        1 =>{
14							dbg!(delta);
15						}
16                        _ => {}
17                    }
18                    scroll
19                }
20	
21		)
22    
23	}
24}

接下来就是需要参考vscode的原始代码我们能发现由若干个动画构成 这里可以在动画包里面找到

 1export class SmoothScrollingOperation {
 2
 3	public readonly from: ISmoothScrollPosition;
 4	public to: ISmoothScrollPosition;
 5	public readonly duration: number;
 6	public readonly startTime: number;
 7	public animationFrameDisposable: IDisposable | null;
 8
 9	private scrollLeft!: IAnimation;
10	private scrollTop!: IAnimation;
11
12	constructor(from: ISmoothScrollPosition, to: ISmoothScrollPosition, startTime: number, duration: number) {
13		this.from = from;
14		this.to = to;
15		this.duration = duration;
16		this.startTime = startTime;
17
18		this.animationFrameDisposable = null;
19
20		this._initAnimations();
21	}
22
23	private _initAnimations(): void {
24		this.scrollLeft = this._initAnimation(this.from.scrollLeft, this.to.scrollLeft, this.to.width);
25		this.scrollTop = this._initAnimation(this.from.scrollTop, this.to.scrollTop, this.to.height);
26	}
27
28	private _initAnimation(from: number, to: number, viewportSize: number): IAnimation {
29		const delta = Math.abs(from - to);
30		if (delta > 2.5 * viewportSize) {
31			let stop1: number, stop2: number;
32			if (from < to) {
33				// scroll to 75% of the viewportSize
34				stop1 = from + 0.75 * viewportSize;
35				stop2 = to - 0.75 * viewportSize;
36			} else {
37				stop1 = from - 0.75 * viewportSize;
38				stop2 = to + 0.75 * viewportSize;
39			}
40			return createComposed(createEaseOutCubic(from, stop1), createEaseOutCubic(stop2, to), 0.33);
41		}
42		return createEaseOutCubic(from, to);
43	}
44
45	public dispose(): void {
46		if (this.animationFrameDisposable !== null) {
47			this.animationFrameDisposable.dispose();
48			this.animationFrameDisposable = null;
49		}
50	}
51
52	public acceptScrollDimensions(state: ScrollState): void {
53		this.to = state.withScrollPosition(this.to);
54		this._initAnimations();
55	}
56
57	public tick(): SmoothScrollingUpdate {
58		return this._tick(Date.now());
59	}
60
61	protected _tick(now: number): SmoothScrollingUpdate {
62		const completion = (now - this.startTime) / this.duration;
63
64		if (completion < 1) {
65			const newScrollLeft = this.scrollLeft(completion);
66			const newScrollTop = this.scrollTop(completion);
67			return new SmoothScrollingUpdate(newScrollLeft, newScrollTop, false);
68		}
69
70		return new SmoothScrollingUpdate(this.to.scrollLeft, this.to.scrollTop, true);
71	}
72
73	public combine(from: ISmoothScrollPosition, to: ISmoothScrollPosition, duration: number): SmoothScrollingOperation {
74		return SmoothScrollingOperation.start(from, to, duration);
75	}
76
77	public static start(from: ISmoothScrollPosition, to: ISmoothScrollPosition, duration: number): SmoothScrollingOperation {
78		// +10 / -10 : pretend the animation already started for a quicker response to a scroll request
79		duration = duration + 10;
80		const startTime = Date.now() - 10;
81
82		return new SmoothScrollingOperation(from, to, startTime, duration);
83	}
84}

item.description: Summary 针对概念性的，如果不看就会忘掉的东西 并且对相对比较复杂的地方需要做一下自己的理解 不要把精力放在过于花哨的类型系统和语法糖，只需要知道有这个东西就行 这里根据我看到的东西 常规语法 循环控制结构 for/while/loop match 匹配 match 生命周期 Trait dyn Trait 虚表结构 +-------------------------------+ | fn drop_in_place(*mut T) | +-------------------------------+ | size of T | +-------------------------------+ | align of T | +-------------------------------+ | fn <T as Grand>::grand_fun1 | +-------------------------------+ | fn <T as Grand>::grand_fun2 | +-------------------------------+ | fn <T as Parent>::parent_fun1 | +-------------------------------+ | fn <T as Parent>::parent_fun2 | +-------------------------------+ | fn <T as Trait>::fun | +-------------------------------+ Trait Specialization 这个理解成对Trait 实现默认的不完全方法 可以通过泛型参数T的约束或者具体的类型来覆盖
item.content:encoded:
Summary

针对概念性的，如果不看就会忘掉的东西 并且对相对比较复杂的地方需要做一下自己的理解 不要把精力放在过于花哨的类型系统和语法糖，只需要知道有这个东西就行 这里根据我看到的东西

常规语法

循环控制结构

for/while/loop

match 匹配

match

生命周期

Trait

dyn Trait

虚表结构

+-------------------------------+
| fn drop_in_place(*mut T)      |
+-------------------------------+
| size of T                     |
+-------------------------------+
| align of T                    |
+-------------------------------+
| fn <T as Grand>::grand_fun1   |
+-------------------------------+
| fn <T as Grand>::grand_fun2   |
+-------------------------------+
| fn <T as Parent>::parent_fun1 |
+-------------------------------+
| fn <T as Parent>::parent_fun2 |
+-------------------------------+
| fn <T as Trait>::fun          |
+-------------------------------+

Trait Specialization

这个理解成对Trait 实现默认的不完全方法 可以通过泛型参数T的约束或者具体的类型来覆盖

Union

竟然有union？没见什么项目用过,更多感觉是为了兼容

有点黑科技

ManuallyDrop

延迟Drop

PhantomData

伪造生命周期或者各种东西 比如说我可以用PhantomData保留一个Status 只有当所有

Pin trait &Pin Project

MaybeUninit

Unsafe

基本跟C++没差了

风格

没对上号的

Drop Check

类似C++的RAII 为了使泛型类型能够正确实现 drop，其泛型参数必须严格地比其存活时间长。 **For a generic type to soundly implement drop, its generics arguments must strictly outlive it. drop order 顺序 我知道有Drop 和RAII但是这个名字对不上号

从样例中间学习

Redis-rs

在内部的fork中我在里面

可变参数泛型

io_uring

了解到是因为有一个字节开发的monoio，使用thread per core 模型 高性能的proxy

所有权

例外就是Cell<T> MutexGuard<’_,T>

内部可变性

Rc Weak UniqueRc Arc RefCell & Cell & UnsafeCell

由于 Rust 的 mutable 特性，一个结构体中的字段，要么全都是 immutable，要么全部是 mutable，不支持针对部分字段进行设置。比如，在一个 struct 中，可能只有个别的字段需要修改，而其他字段并不需要修改，为了一个字段而将整个 struct 变为 &mut 也是不合理的。

所以，实现 内部可变性 的 Cell 和 RefCell 正是为了解决诸如这类问题存在的，通过它们可以实现 struct 部分字段可变，而不用将整个 struct 设置为 mutable。

一个比较漂亮的方案 View Type

所以有view type 出现,因为大多数情况我们都是同一个结构体部分借用 https://smallcultfollowing.com/babysteps/blog/2021/11/05/view-types/ https://hackmd.io/J5aGp1ptT46lqLmPVVOxzg?view

Tokio

trait 泛型

Send/Sync

Send 是 我可以将其移动到另一个线程而不创建非线程安全的隐藏共享状态吗？ Rc 移动后保持共享状态

Sync 是 多个线程是否可以保存对此的引用，而不会发生突变竞争（当且仅当&T是Send的时候T才是Sync）

特例:

e.g. 通过通过libloading载入dll,为了防止线程局部变量出问题!Send(需要由创建他的线程释放),!Sync(并没有做读写访问控制)

e.g. MutexGuard<T> 由于pthread平台限制(如果你把它发送到别的线程那么析构函数会在被发送到的线程执行,但是你可以Send &MutexGuard<T>) !Send Sync(因为要Deref)

https://blog.cuongle.dev/p/this-sendsync-secret-separates-professional-and-amateur

FFI

宏

奇怪语法糖

泛型相关

HRTB

具体表现是for<‘a>:Trait<‘a>

1//将生命周期推迟到调用者来决定
2fn with_nested_refcell<'nested> (
3   nested: &'nested RefCell<RefCell<str>>,
4   f: for<'arg> fn(&'arg str), // ≈ fn<'arg> (&'arg str),
5)
6{
7   f(&*nested.borrow().borrow())
8}

RPIT

return position impl Trait RPIT 并不是泛型

1fn test_rpit() -> impl Iterator<Item = i32> {    
2	 [1, 2, 3, 4].into_iter() 
3 }

GAT

泛型关联类型

1trait ConvertTo: Sized {
2     type Inner;     
3     type Output<Item>     
4     where         
5	     Item: From<Self::Inner>;      
6	fn convert_to<U>(self) -> Self::Output<U>
7	where
8	        U: From<Self::Inner>; 
9}

我可以将函数上面的泛型类型参数U和Output泛型类型参数绑定到一起(生命周期什么的都可以传递过去了)

RPITIT

Return Position impl Trait In Traits RPITIT 解糖为关联类型或 GAT

AFIT

rust的async函数脱糖目标是RPIT（也是#[async_trait] expend的结果）

1async fn get_one()->i32{
2	1
3}
4//脱糖到
5fn get_one() -> impl Future<Output=i32>{
6	async {1}
7}

同样道理 async fn In Traits 就会脱糖到RPITIT AFIT-> RPITIT -> GAT/关联类型

Connect

Reference

https://nihil.cc/posts/rust_rpitit_afit/
